narratives.Description: bug(agents-entry): managed AGENTS.md cites templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md, which does not exist in a consumer project (regression from #7152)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Since 0.131.4, two lines in the AGENTS.md managed section cite `templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md`. In a consumer project that path does not exist. The file is at `node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md`, which is what 0.131.3 rendered.

Source: internal benchmark evidence (private). Seen in the managed-section diff of a 0.131.3 → 0.131.4 upgrade.

## Cause

Upstream commit `215047ddf` (PR #7152, "add the #480 kernel to the issue-read line") changed `content/templates/agents-entry.md`:

- Line 53 (Umbrella status reading, #2066): `full contract: node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md § 5.6` became `full contract: templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md § 5.6`.
- Line 63 (Issue body→comments reading, #2143): the same prefix was dropped.

The parent commit `14b6539de` still has the full path on both lines. The same new line 63 also says "first read main.md § Agent Trap Defenses" without the prefix, although the managed section's opening gives the full path `node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime/main.md`.

## Impact

An agent that follows the pointer (for § 5.6 before dispatch, or the #2143 read rule) finds no file. It then guesses a path or skips the read. The AGENTS.md guidance against inventing payload paths makes a guess the wrong recovery.

## Expected

The rendered consumer AGENTS.md cites paths that exist in a consumer project.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Given a consumer install, when AGENTS.md is rendered, then each `templates/…` and `main.md` reference in the managed section resolves to an existing file from the project root (`node_modules/@deftai/directive-runtime/…`).
- [ ] A content-contract test fails if a managed-section path reference does not resolve in a consumer layout.

## Related

#7152, #4949, #480, #2066, #2143.
